definitions.explanation: A formal request or application to participate in, subscribe to, or receive something.

examples.japanese: {申|もう}し{込|こ}みは{明日|あした}までです。
コースへの{申|もう}し{込|こ}みをした。
{申|もう}し{込|こ}み{方法|ほうほう}を{教|おし}えてください。
examples.english: Please tell me how to apply.

notes:
COMPOUND: {申|もう}し{込|こ}む (to apply) → noun form

COMMON EXPRESSIONS:
- {申|もう}し{込|こ}みをする (to apply)
- {申|もう}し{込|こ}み{締|し}め{切|き}り (application deadline)
- {申|もう}し{込|こ}み{用紙|ようし} (application form)
- {申|もう}し{込|こ}み{方法|ほうほう} (application method)
- {申|もう}し{込|こ}み{先|さき} (where to apply)

CONTEXTS:
- Course/class registration
- Event participation
- Service subscription
- Contest/competition entry

RELATED: {申込書|もうしこみしょ} (application form)
